title: A picture model that never answers costs a place its drawing at the Apply's deadline, never the Apply its words
steps: S1: Run the real shapeReal (apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/real-pictures.js) for a Joomla demo with one exterior photo, a picture door set, a chat stand-in that never resolves, drawMs 60 s and an Apply signal aborted after 100 ms.
S2: Run the real drawForPlace (apps/tracy-web/src/lib/picture-draw.js) with a chat that never resolves and a signal aborted after 50 ms.

S3: Run brief-joomla.test.mjs cases for fictional bakery and dental briefs with portrait owner photos and a stalled picture reader. Picture preparation expires before the real engine writes through the pinned Joomla PHP validator.
S4: Run brief-drawing-failures.test.mjs and brief-picture-preparation.test.mjs for hanging cache/reference/labeller/model dependencies and stop-grace completion.
S5: Run brief-sharpness-display.test.mjs for portrait owner photos in a hero whose upload minimum is 2160 pixels and CSS display width is 1440 pixels.
expect: S1: shapeReal resolves in under 10 s, notes 'a picture could not be drawn: the picture took too long', and no shaped place has receipt.kind 'drawn'.
S2: drawForPlace rejects with 'the picture took too long' in under 5 s.

S3: Preparation makes no CMS writes. After its deadline the engine still writes text, telephone, social link, map and owner-name logo, removes the blog menu and never retries the stalled picture reader.

S4: Expired drawing work starts no queued provider call; provider timeouts do not retry; refused faces or lettering receive at most one redraw and safe class logs; completed paid calls and known costs remain counted. Owner/neutral shapes returned during stop grace are retained; late completions cannot replace them after writes start.
S5: Both trades keep the sharp owner photo, judge its actual CSS display size and upload at the density the real plugin requires.

selectors.code: preparePicturesBeforeApply, engine.preparePictures, pictureDeadline, drawForPlace signal race, slotClassOf CSS display size

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: drawForPlace called the seeder's chat (240 s x 3 tries) with no race while the Apply's words wait for its pictures under a 180 s deadline (#1367 symptom on opportunity demos)
fence: Joomla/WordPress prepare real pictures under a separate bounded clock before applyMs; the write phase consumes a completed shape once or skips it. Drawing dependencies, retries and post-processing respect cancellation; plugin checks remain enforced.

tests: a picture model that never answers costs the place its drawing, never the Apply its words
a model that never answers is given up at the signal, not waited on through its own retries
Copperleaf Bakery: stalled picture preparation leaves the full text write phase available
Northgate Dental: stalled picture preparation leaves the full text write phase available
completed picture preparation is consumed once, with fresh plugin validation before writing
stopping drawing keeps the owner photos and neutral fills returned during the stop grace
sports coaching: a timed-out provider is not called again while its first request may still run
#189 bakery: portrait owner photos use the hero display size, then satisfy the real plugin density check
#189 dental: portrait owner photos use the hero display size, then satisfy the real plugin density check
